back: ALB: layer 7 (HTTP, path/host routing). NLB: layer 4 (TCP/UDP, ultra-low latency). GWLB: third-party security appliances.

es.back: ALB: capa 7 (HTTP, enrutamiento por ruta/host). NLB: capa 4 (TCP/UDP, ultra baja latencia). GWLB: appliances de seguridad de terceros.

back: Keeps the desired number of instances, scales with policies (target tracking, scheduled, predictive), and replaces unhealthy instances.

es.back: Mantiene el número deseado de instancias, escala según políticas (target tracking, programado, predictivo) y reemplaza instancias no saludables.

back: Fleet management: Session Manager (access without SSH), Patch Manager, Run Command, Parameter Store, Automation.

es.back: Administración de flotas: Session Manager (acceso sin SSH), Patch Manager, Run Command, Parameter Store, Automation.

back: Status of AWS services and events that affect the resources in your account (maintenance, incidents).

es.back: Estado de los servicios de AWS y eventos que afectan a los recursos de tu cuenta (mantenimientos, incidentes).

back: Athena (SQL over S3), Glue (ETL and catalog), EMR (Spark/Hadoop), Kinesis (streaming), QuickSight (BI), Redshift (data warehouse), OpenSearch (search/logs).

es.back: Athena (SQL sobre S3), Glue (ETL y catálogo), EMR (Spark/Hadoop), Kinesis (streaming), QuickSight (BI), Redshift (data warehouse), OpenSearch (búsqueda/logs).

back: Rekognition (images/video), Comprehend (NLP), Textract (documents), Transcribe (speech to text), Polly (text to speech), Translate, Lex (chatbots), Kendra (search), Personalize (recommendations).

es.back: Rekognition (imágenes/video), Comprehend (NLP), Textract (documentos), Transcribe (voz→texto), Polly (texto→voz), Translate, Lex (chatbots), Kendra (búsqueda), Personalize (recomendaciones).

front: SageMaker AI vs Bedrock vs Amazon Q
back: SageMaker AI: build, train, and deploy your own models. Bedrock: access to foundation models through an API. Amazon Q: generative AI assistant for businesses and developers.

es.front: SageMaker AI vs Bedrock vs Amazon Q
es.back: SageMaker AI: construir, entrenar y desplegar tus propios modelos. Bedrock: acceso a modelos fundacionales por API. Amazon Q: asistente de IA generativa para empresas y desarrolladores.

back: SQS: message queue (pull, decouples producers and consumers). SNS: pub/sub (push to many subscribers). EventBridge: event bus with rules and SaaS sources.

es.back: SQS: cola de mensajes (pull, desacopla productores y consumidores). SNS: pub/sub (push a múltiples suscriptores). EventBridge: bus de eventos con reglas y fuentes SaaS.

back: Orchestrates multi-step workflows (Lambda and other services) as visual state machines, with retries and error handling.

es.back: Orquesta flujos de trabajo con varios pasos (Lambda y otros servicios) como máquinas de estado visuales, con reintentos y manejo de errores.

back: CodePipeline (orchestrates), CodeBuild (builds/tests), CodeDeploy (deploys), CodeArtifact (packages), X-Ray (traces), CloudShell (browser terminal). CodeCommit and Cloud9 are closed to new customers.

es.back: CodePipeline (orquesta), CodeBuild (compila/prueba), CodeDeploy (despliega), CodeArtifact (paquetes), X-Ray (trazas), CloudShell (terminal en el navegador). CodeCommit y Cloud9 ya no aceptan clientes nuevos.

front: CloudFormation vs CDK vs Elastic Beanstalk
back: CloudFormation: IaC with JSON/YAML templates. CDK: IaC with programming languages (generates CloudFormation). Beanstalk: PaaS that deploys your app and manages the infrastructure.

es.front: CloudFormation vs CDK vs Elastic Beanstalk
es.back: CloudFormation: IaC con plantillas JSON/YAML. CDK: IaC con lenguajes de programación (genera CloudFormation). Beanstalk: PaaS que despliega tu app y administra la infraestructura.

back: Compute, storage, and outbound data transfer. Inbound data transfer is usually free.

es.front: 3 impulsores fundamentales del costo en AWS
es.back: Cómputo, almacenamiento y transferencia de datos de salida. La transferencia de entrada suele ser gratuita.

back: Compute Savings Plans (EC2 of any family/Region, Fargate, and Lambda) and EC2 Instance Savings Plans (one family in one Region, larger discount). There are also SageMaker AI Savings Plans.

es.back: Compute Savings Plans (EC2 de cualquier familia/región, Fargate y Lambda) y EC2 Instance Savings Plans (una familia en una región, mayor descuento). También hay SageMaker AI Savings Plans.

back: IAM, VPC (the network itself), Organizations, CloudFormation, Elastic Beanstalk, and Auto Scaling: you pay only for the resources they use.

es.back: IAM, VPC (la red en sí), Organizations, CloudFormation, Elastic Beanstalk y Auto Scaling: pagas sólo los recursos que usan.

front: Budgets vs Cost Explorer vs Pricing Calculator
back: Budgets: alerts and actions on budgets. Cost Explorer: analyze and forecast spending. Pricing Calculator: estimate costs before deploying.

es.front: Budgets vs Cost Explorer vs Pricing Calculator
es.back: Budgets: alertas y acciones sobre presupuestos. Cost Explorer: analizar y pronosticar gasto. Pricing Calculator: estimar costos antes de desplegar.

back: The most detailed (hourly, per resource) report of costs and usage, delivered to S3; analyzed with Athena or QuickSight.

es.back: El informe más detallado (por hora y recurso) de costos y uso, entregado a S3; se analiza con Athena o QuickSight.

back: Tags activated in Billing to group and filter costs by project, team, or environment.

es.back: Etiquetas activadas en Billing para agrupar y filtrar costos por proyecto, equipo o entorno.

back: Manages multiple accounts: consolidated billing (shared volume discounts), OUs, and service control policies (SCPs).

es.back: Gestiona varias cuentas: facturación consolidada (descuentos por volumen compartidos), OU y Service Control Policies (SCP).

back: Basic (free). Business Support+: 24/7 phone/chat, full Trusted Advisor, < 30 min for critical system down. Enterprise Support: designated TAM, < 15 min. Unified Operations: < 5 min, 24/7 workload monitoring.

es.back: Basic (gratis). Business Support+: 24/7 por teléfono/chat, Trusted Advisor completo, < 30 min para sistema crítico caído. Enterprise Support: TAM designado, < 15 min. Unified Operations: < 5 min y monitoreo 24/7 de cargas.

back: AWS re:Post (community), Knowledge Center, documentation, AWS Marketplace (third-party software), Professional Services and the Partner Network, Trust & Safety (report abuse).

es.back: AWS re:Post (comunidad), Knowledge Center, documentación, AWS Marketplace (software de terceros), Professional Services y Partner Network, Trust & Safety (reportar abuso).
